lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName} Commander?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Are you still using this number?
Yes. How have you been?
Is that you, Old Man?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Not quite.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I'm his grandson.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I found this cell phone while sorting through my grandfather's belongings.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: It looks like you were the last person

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: he communicated with.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I was hesitant at first, but then I decided to contact you.
I'm sorry for your loss.
How did he pass?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: He passed away

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: in his sleep.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: No problems with the funeral.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: He passed away in his sleep.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: For the longest time, I had no idea why he seemed so at peace,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: but then I saw the messages sent between you and him,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: and then I knew.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: There were no problems with the funeral.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: We had him cremated, and arranged for his remains to be sent to a columbarium.
There's a pregnant pause, as if the grandson is debating whether or not to continue.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: You've already done so much for my grandfather, and

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I feel terrible asking you for yet another favor, but if it's at all within your capacity,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: could you confirm

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: if his ashes made it

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: to the columbarium safely?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: At first, there was no space left,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: but then one opened up a while back.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I've been so busy with work that I haven't had time to go there myself.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I have complete faith in the employees at the actual columbarium,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: but what with all the recent happenings in the Ark,

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I haven't been able to get a confirmation.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: If you could just make sure that everything is okay, I'd be so grateful.
Where is the columbarium?

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: It's near the entrance to downtown.
If you give me the exact location, I can go have a look.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I'll send you the address right away.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I can't thank you enough.

lines.speaker: grandpa
lines.text: I'll repay you somehow, I promise.
